elements.text:
**How collaboration works**

The host opens a document with their Git credentials and clicks Invite collaborators.
They share a link. Guests join with just a name — no account, no token, nothing to install.
Everyone edits the same board live: cursors, selections, and changes appear in real time.
Sharing is scoped — invite people to a single board, a chapter, or the whole document.
The host owns saving to Git; guests edit freely, and the host commits the result.
Invite links have a lifetime you choose (1–30 days) and can be revoked anytime.
Only host user can save the collab work
